title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 Full Length Mock Test 04 (Hard Level)
description: Hard Level Full Length Mock Test for SSC CHSL Tier-1. 100 Questions | 60 Minutes | Reasoning 25, GA 25, Quant 25, English 25.
instructions: Yeh Hard Level Full Length Mock Test hai.
Total 100 questions: Reasoning 25, General Awareness 25, Quantitative Aptitude 25, English 25.
Har question 2 marks ka hai. Galat jawab par 0.5 marks katenge.
SSC CHSL Tier-1 latest pattern ke anusar.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Microphone : Loudness :: Thermometer : ?
questions.explanation: Microphone measures/relates to loudness (sound intensity); thermometer measures temperature.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Find the missing term: 3, 10, 29, 66, 127, ?

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If ORANGE is written as RQDPHJ, how is BANANA written?
questions.explanation: Each letter +3: B→E, A→D, N→Q, A→D, N→Q, A→D gives EDQDPD.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: A is the mother of B. C is the sister of A. D is the son of C. E is the brother of B. How is D related to E?
questions.explanation: D is son of C, and C is sister of A (mother of B and E). So D is cousin of E.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: From point P, a person walks 8 km East, then 6 km North, then 4 km West, then 6 km South. How far is he from P?
questions.explanation: Net East = 8-4=4 km; North and South cancel. Distance = 4 km.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Statements: All parks are gardens. Some gardens are playgrounds. Conclusions: I. Some parks are playgrounds. II. Some playgrounds are gardens.
questions.explanation: I does not necessarily follow. II follows from 'Some gardens are playgrounds'.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If the word QUALITY is seen in a mirror placed to the right of the word, which letter appears at the extreme left of the mirror image?
questions.explanation: Mirror reverses left-right order, so last letter Y appears at the extreme left.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: A square paper is folded once along the diagonal and a hole is punched near the centre of the fold. How many holes will appear when unfolded?
questions.explanation: One fold through the diagonal produces two layers; one punch gives two holes after unfolding.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Five friends A, B, C, D, E sit in a row facing North. C sits second to the right of A. B sits at one end. D sits between A and B. Who sits at the other end?
questions.explanation: Possible: B D A C E (B at left end). Other end is E.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If 15 August 2024 was Thursday, what day was 15 August 2025?
questions.explanation: 2025 is not a leap year from 15 Aug 2024 to 15 Aug 2025 (29 Feb 2024 already passed). 365 days = 1 odd day. Thursday + 1 = Friday.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: At what time between 3 and 4 o'clock are the hands of a clock at right angles for the first time?
questions.explanation: Hands are at right angles when minute hand is at 16 4/11 minutes past 3. Formula: M = (1/11)(60H ± 90); first valid time after 3 is 16 4/11 min.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Which diagram best represents Earth, Continent, Country?
questions.explanation: Countries lie in continents, continents lie on Earth: concentric inclusion.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Statement: 'Use our branded oil for a healthy heart.' Assumptions: I. People desire a healthy heart. II. Other oils are harmful.
questions.explanation: The appeal assumes people want heart health. It does not assume other oils are harmful.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If P ≥ Q = R > S ≤ T, which is definitely true?
questions.explanation: P ≥ Q = R > S so P > S always.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Find the next term: AZ, CX, EV, GT, ?
questions.explanation: First letters A,C,E,G,+2 → I; second Z,X,V,T,−2 → R. IR.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: A cube is painted red on all faces and cut into 64 smaller equal cubes. How many small cubes have exactly two faces painted?
questions.explanation: 4×4×4 cube: edge cubes excluding corners: 12 edges × 2 = 24.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: In a class of 40, A ranks 12th from top and B ranks 9th from bottom. If C is exactly midway between A and B, what is C's rank from the top?
questions.explanation: B from top = 40-9+1=32. Positions from A(12) to B(32) inclusive: 21 students. Midway is 12+10=22nd.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If + means ÷, ÷ means −, − means ×, × means +, then 36 + 6 ÷ 3 − 2 × 4 = ?
questions.explanation: After substitution: 36 ÷ 6 − 3 × 2 + 4. BODMAS: 6 − 6 + 4 = 4.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Statement: All poets are singers. Some singers are dancers. Conclusions: I. Some poets are dancers. II. No poet is a dancer.
questions.explanation: I and II form a complementary pair (some vs none). Either-or follows.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Two positions of a dice are shown. If 1 is opposite 6 and 2 is opposite 5, which is opposite 3?
questions.explanation: Remaining pair is 3 and 4.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: The water image of the letter 'F' most closely resembles which orientation?
questions.explanation: Water image is a vertical flip, so F appears inverted.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Find the missing number: 2, 3, 6 ; 3, 4, 12 ; 4, 5, ?

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Arrange in meaningful order: 1. Seed 2. Plant 3. Fruit 4. Flower 5. Tree
questions.explanation: Seed → Plant → Tree → Flower → Fruit.

questions.subject: General Awareness

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: The Battle of Plassey was fought in which year?

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: Which of the following is the longest river in India by length within the country?
questions.explanation: Ganga is the longest river flowing within India among the given options (overall Ganga system).

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: Repo rate is the rate at which RBI
options: Lends short-term funds to commercial banks
questions.explanation: Repo rate is the policy rate at which RBI injects liquidity by lending to banks against securities.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: Bharat Ratna was first awarded in which year?
questions.explanation: The first Bharat Ratna awards were conferred in 1954.

questions.subject: General Awareness

questions.explanation: LBW (leg before wicket) is a mode of dismissal in cricket.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: Kathakali is a classical dance form of which state?
questions.explanation: Kathakali originated and is practised in Kerala.

questions.subject: General Awareness

questions.subject: General Awareness

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: Tropic of Cancer does NOT pass through which Indian state?
questions.explanation: Tropic of Cancer passes through 8 states; Odisha is not among them.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: SI unit of electric resistance is
questions.explanation: Resistance is measured in ohm (Ω).

questions.subject: General Awareness

questions.explanation: GST came into force on 1 July 2017.

questions.subject: General Awareness

questions.explanation: Nehru wrote The Discovery of India during imprisonment at Ahmednagar Fort.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: Headquarters of the International Court of Justice is at
questions.explanation: ICJ sits at the Peace Palace in The Hague, Netherlands.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: Which vitamin is synthesised in the human skin in presence of sunlight?
questions.explanation: UV-B converts 7-dehydrocholesterol in skin to vitamin D3.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: The Rowlatt Act was passed in which year?
questions.explanation: The Anarchical and Revolutionary Crimes Act (Rowlatt Act) was passed in 1919.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: Which is the highest peak in India (within Indian-administered territory commonly asked as Kangchenjunga)?
questions.explanation: Kangchenjunga (8586 m) is the highest peak in India; K2 lies in PoK.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: Fundamental Duties were added by which Amendment?
questions.explanation: 42nd Amendment, 1976 added Part IVA (Article 51A) on Fundamental Duties.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: Which of the following is a volatile memory?
questions.explanation: RAM loses data when power is off; it is volatile.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: The process of conversion of a solid directly into gas is called
questions.explanation: Sublimation is solid → gas without liquid phase (e.g., camphor, dry ice).

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: Which of the following is a direct tax?
questions.explanation: Income tax is levied directly on the income of persons; GST/customs/excise are indirect.

questions.subject: General Awareness
questions.question: Olympic Games are held after every how many years?
questions.explanation: Summer and Winter Olympics each follow a four-year cycle.

questions.question: If the price of sugar rises by 25%, by what percent should a family reduce consumption so that expenditure remains the same?
questions.explanation: Required reduction = r/(100+r)×100 = 25/125×100 = 20%.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Choose the synonym of 'Adept'.
questions.explanation: Adept means highly skilled or proficient.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Choose the antonym of 'Scarce'.
questions.explanation: Scarce means insufficient; abundant is the opposite.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: 'To bury the hatchet' means
questions.explanation: The idiom means to end a quarrel and reconcile.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: A person who loves mankind is called
questions.explanation: Philanthropist = lover of humanity; misanthrope is the opposite.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Identify the part with error: The committee / have decided / to postpone / the meeting.
questions.explanation: Collective noun 'committee' as a unit takes singular verb: has decided.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: She has been working here _____ 2019.
questions.explanation: 'Since' is used with a point of time.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Change into passive: 'They are painting the house.'
options: The house is being painted by them.
The house was painted by them.
The house has been painted by them.
The house is painted by them.
questions.explanation: Present continuous active → is/are being + V3.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: He said, 'I am unwell.' Choose correct indirect speech.
options: He said that he was unwell.
He said that I am unwell.
He said that he is unwell.
He told that he was unwell.
questions.explanation: Present changes to past in indirect speech when reporting verb is past.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Choose the correctly spelled word.
questions.explanation: Correct spelling is embarrass.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: 'A blessing in disguise' means
options: Something good that seemed bad at first
questions.explanation: The phrase refers to an apparent misfortune that later proves beneficial.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Synonym of 'Obsolete' is
questions.explanation: Obsolete means no longer in use; outdated.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Antonym of 'Generous' is
questions.explanation: Generous means giving freely; miserly is tight-fisted.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Arrange: P. he sat down Q. tired after the journey R. and fell asleep S. immediately
questions.explanation: Tired after the journey he sat down and fell asleep immediately → QPRS.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: The sun _____ in the east.
questions.explanation: Simple present for universal truth: rises.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: He is good _____ mathematics.
questions.explanation: The correct collocation is 'good at'.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: A speech delivered without any previous preparation is
questions.explanation: Extempore means spoken without notes or rehearsal.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Find the error: Neither of the two boys / have submitted / their assignment / yet.
questions.explanation: 'Neither' takes a singular verb: has submitted.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Active of: 'The letter was written by Sita.'
questions.explanation: Past simple passive → past simple active.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: 'Ephemeral' means
questions.explanation: Ephemeral means lasting for a very short time.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: I will not go _____ you come with me.
questions.explanation: 'Unless' means 'if not' and fits the condition.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: He is _____ honest man.
questions.explanation: 'Honest' begins with a vowel sound, so 'an'.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: 'Hit the nail on the head' means
questions.explanation: The idiom means to describe or do something with complete accuracy.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Synonym of 'Diligent' is
questions.explanation: Diligent means showing care and conscientious effort.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Antonym of 'Transparent' is
questions.explanation: Transparent allows light through; opaque does not.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Choose the correct meaning of 'to call a spade a spade'.
questions.explanation: The idiom means to speak plainly and truthfully without euphemism.
